_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Reads the signed-in person's Needs-you and Updates inbox with counts and next-step tools for proactive fixes.

description: Account notification inbox (Needs you · Updates). Summary-first: tab counts plus compact rows with nextAction (MCP tool or dashboard URL). OAuth person only — not API keys.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

scope.description: Scope filter (default all workspaces you belong to).

slug.description: Site slug — required when scope is site.

tab.description: Tab filter (default: both classes in one list).

name: list_notifications
